title: Inner seal comes off constantly
text: Inner seal comes off constantly. Wanted to love this. The plastic is not quite as heavy and thick as I'd hoped. But the biggest bummer is that the gray inner seal on the lid comes off every single time you open it. I've never had a product that claimed to be airtight have this problem.
